A '''township''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Battle of Ord Mantell (Clone Wars)|attacked]] the planet and engaged the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces there. To ensure his escape, Grievous razed this township, [[Death/Legends|murdering]] the inhabitants.
